16KPa high suction power, deep dust removal throughout the house

Built-in 1000W high-power motor, stable output of 16KPa strong suction power. It can thoroughly collect floating dust, food debris, and fine dust on hard surfaces such as wooden floors and tiles. It is fully sufficient for daily home cleaning.

Lightweight 360° swivel movement, effortless cleaning

The entire machine weighs only 9 pounds, lightweight body for easy carrying; paired with 360° swivel wheels, smooth and effortless pushing and pulling without resistance. It is flexible and handy for moving through various rooms and up and down stairs, significantly reducing the fatigue of cleaning.

1.8L large capacity dust cup + washable HEPA filter

1.8L large capacity dust cup, no need to frequently empty the dust during the entire house cleaning; the HEPA high-density filter can be repeatedly washed, firmly locking in fine dust, pollen and other allergenic particles, reducing the cost of filter replacement, with full home affordability.

Thin body + automatic cable retraction, friendly storage for small spaces

The body is lightweight and compact, equipped with an automatic cable retraction design, automatically storing the wires without being messy; it can be easily placed in apartments, campers, small storage cabinets, narrow corners, etc., without occupying extra space in the home.

Multifunctional three-in-one complete set of accessories, no  cleaning

Standard accessories include telescopic hose， floor main brush， fabric sofa brush， two-in-one gap dusting brush. It covers bed bottoms， sofa gaps， skirting lines， and furniture edges and corners， cleaning all hidden dust corners in the home at once.
